title: Unavailable-detector copy must name the outcome, not a cause; keep surfaces in sync
answers: Where is the AI detector could not complete this check message defined?
Renaming the provider_unavailable email template context key
body:
`LLMDetectorUnavailableError` covers rollout-lookup empty, no free model-call slot, provider transport failure and unreadable model reply, so copy must not claim a provider outage or that settings are correct.
Change together:
- `products/alerts/backend/judge/contract.py:LLM_DETECTOR_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE`
- `posthog/temporal/alerts/activities.py:dispatch_alert_error_in_app_notifications` (in-app body)
- `posthog/tasks/alerts/utils.py:send_notifications_for_errors` (context key `detector_unavailable`)
- `posthog/templates/email/alert_check_failed_to_evaluate.html` (reads `detector_unavailable`)
- assertions in `test_alerts_activities.py`, `test_email_notifications.py`, `products/alerts/backend/tests/api/test_alert.py` (allowlisted error code message).
applies: Owner-facing error messaging for AI detector failures
